decision: accept strategy subject to explicit copy-stability and audit-copy validation; not final material approval

observed_inventory.method: Raw stat/hash only; no sqlite3 connection or source/canonical writes

rationale: A nonempty WAL can hold pages not present in main DB; blindly excluding it risks losing original committed evidence. Preserve main+nonempty WAL under original matching names/relative directory.

Official template bars still-being-written DB temporary files; previous service cleanup plus no further writers and stable finite capture must be evidenced. Nonempty is not by itself proof of live writing or logical correctness.
SHM/empty WAL/journal exclusions and five nonempty-WAL inclusion exceptions must be explicit in frozen scope; keep early review unchanged and record this revision.
mandatory_checks: Before copying capture DB and WAL path/size/mtime_ns/SHA for the complete pair; after both copies rehash/re-stat both original files. Every copied file must equal recorded original bytes/hash, all source before/after facts unchanged.

Preserve main DB and WAL matching file names and directory association in canonical snapshot; no SQLite open/checkpoint/repair on originals or canonical copy. Inclusion exception must take precedence over generic sidecar/runtime exclusions.

Duplicate only the canonical pair to a separate validation audit directory. Run PRAGMA integrity_check on this audit logical DB+WAL view; capture connection parameters, exit/errors, SQLite version and result. Do not claim main-only integrity as DB+WAL audit.

Record audit table names/counts or relevant logical state where feasible to show readable evidence; integrity_ok is not a functional acceptance pass. Audit may create/change SHM/WAL/checkpoint pages only in this disposable audit copy.
After audit verify canonical DB/WAL SHA/size/mtime remain exactly unchanged; audit artifacts stay excluded validation outputs.
Missing partner, changed source/canonical facts, copying mismatch, SQLite errors or non-ok integrity must fail/stop rather than omit the WAL or silently repair canonical evidence.
